objective: Test whether a SLOWER trend gate -- do not sell put-side premium when the underlying is below its 200-day moving average (instead of the 50-day) -- catches more of the 2022 bear that v4's 50-day gate let back in on bear-market rallies, and what it costs.
motivation: v4 (50-day gate) cut the 2022 loss only 39% (-$7025 -> -$4300) because bear-market rallies poke back above the fast 50-day, re-admitting put-side trades right before the downtrend resumes. A 200-day SMA stays below price for the whole bear, so the gate should hold defense through 2022. The expected cost: the 200-day is slow to turn back on after a bottom, so post-bear RECOVERY premium (e.g. 2020 rebound, 2023 H2, early recovery months) may be given up.
hypothesis: The 200-day gate reduces the 2022 loss more than v4 did, at the cost of some recovery-year upside; net cluster-adjusted total is at least as good as v4 (+$3293).

change_from_v4.only_change: Trend gate measure = 200-day SMA instead of 50-day. Rule unchanged: below the average -> drop put_spread + iron_condor; call spreads still allowed. Everything else identical to v3/v4.
change_from_v4.single_lever: Only the SMA window changes, so the effect is attributable. A market-wide (index-level) kill switch is deliberately NOT added here -- that is a separate future variant.

falsifiable_predictions: 2022 loss is smaller than v4's -$4300 (the slower gate holds defense through the bear)
at least one recovery window loses upside vs v4 (2020 and/or 2023 give back some gain because the 200-day re-admits put-side late)
cluster-adjusted total is >= v4 (+$3293); if it is worse, the slower gate over-defended and 50-day was better

guardrails.no_p_hacking: Registered ONCE with the 200-day window fixed before running. If 200 is worse than 50, we report that; we do NOT then sweep windows to find the best -- a window sweep would be a single, separately pre-registered experiment that counts every window as a trial.
guardrails.gate_unchanged: Canonical thresholds fixed (PBO<0.5 AND DSR>0). Fewer trades raise the deflation bar.
guardrails.same_deviations: Proxied IV, constant-IV repricing, model credit carry over -- results remain an UPPER BOUND.

trial_accounting.reason: same 31 symbols x 3 structures; the 200-day gate is a fixed rule.

promotion: No promotion. Informs which trend measure (if any) belongs in the live desk. SHADOW throughout.
